label: Shaolin Monk
description: a calm, athletic Shaolin monk: shaved head, an orange-and-yellow monk robe tied at the waist with a brown sash and draped over one shoulder leaving one arm bare, large wooden prayer beads around the neck, white leg wraps, black cloth shoes

portrait.prompt: Now something different: NOT a sprite sheet. Draw ONE single square character-select portrait (one image, no grid, no frames) of the same character ({description}), in the same pixel-art style but more detailed: chest-up close-up, the face large with a serene but intense expression, one open palm raised in front of the chest with small orange flames, the head turned three-quarters toward the right, dramatic rim lighting. Solid deep red background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: A calm, rooted kung-fu horse fighting stance. The feet stay in the same place in every frame; only the body bobs and breathes.
poses: rest pose in the guard stance
body dips about 2 pixels, shoulders relax
returning to the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A guarded step toward the RIGHT. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place).
poses: contact: front (right) foot stepping forward, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A retreating step: still FACING RIGHT toward the enemy, guard up, stepping backward (to the left). The character stays centred in its cell.
poses: contact: back (left) foot placed behind, guard up
down: weight shifts, knees bend, body dips slightly
passing: the free leg moves past the planted leg
passing, opposite leg, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: Six clearly DIFFERENT poses going from standing down to kneeling; the feet stay on the same ground line.
poses: standing guard stance exactly as in the reference, full height
half squat, knees bent, head clearly lower than in frame 1
dropping to one knee, the back knee almost touching the ground
kneeling on one knee, guard up, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line. Keep the character horizontally centred in its cell.
poses: anticipation: deep crouch, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, feet leaving the ground
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees tucked
landing: feet back on the ground line, knees bent absorbing the impact

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted. The block pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to raise both forearms
both open palms crossed in front of the face
block held: both open palms crossed in front of the face and chest, body braced

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the ground line. Goes from standing to a LOW crouching block held from frame 3 onward.
poses: crouching low, forearms lowering in front of the knees
block held: deep low crouch, forearms guarding the shins, body only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Struck in the face from the RIGHT, recoiling backward to the LEFT; feet stay near the ground line.
poses: impact: head snaps back, eyes shut
maximum recoil: torso bent far back, one foot sliding
back in the guard stance with a pained face

actions.label: Palm Strike
actions.note: A fast open-palm strike pushing forward to the RIGHT at chest height. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: strike: the open palm thrust forward to the RIGHT at chest height
full extension: the open palm thrust forward to the RIGHT at chest height, a short white impact streak

actions.label: Sweep Kick
actions.note: A low sweeping kick along the ground toward the RIGHT, aimed at the shins. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: guard stance, weight shifting onto the back leg
wind-up, body turning, the kicking leg chambered
kick: the leg sweeping forward to the RIGHT near the ground, a motion arc behind the leg
full extension: the leg sweeping forward to the RIGHT near the ground

actions.label: Inner Fire
actions.note: Powering up in place; feet stay planted. Orange flames grow around both hands and an orange aura rises around the body.

actions.label: Burning Palm
actions.note: IMPORTANT: NINE frames in a 3x3 grid (3 columns and 3 ROWS). A three-hit combo toward the RIGHT. The strike frames are 3, 5 and 7; frames 4, 6 and 8 are transitions. Orange fire trails follow the palms (orange and yellow only).
poses: first hit: a flaming palm thrust toward the RIGHT
second hit: a spinning flaming palm toward the RIGHT
third hit, the finisher: a double-palm strike releasing a big orange fire burst toward the RIGHT, a large burst

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: Hit from the RIGHT, falling backward to the LEFT, ending lying on the back with the head to the left and the feet to the right. The lying body must fit inside its cell.
poses: hitting the ground on the back, dust puff
lying flat, head to the left, feet to the right
